resources.string: Restore merges the backup into this device. When an item exists in both — a provider, a model\'s settings or a model group with the same name — the backup\'s version is used, even if the one on this device is newer. That includes API keys; an account signed in on this device is kept unless its sign-in has expired. Nothing that exists only on this device is deleted.
Credentials were restored for %1$d provider(s) from the backup. The backup\'s API keys replace the ones on this device; an account signed in on this device is kept unless its sign-in had expired.
No credentials were changed: the API keys on this device already match the backup, and accounts signed in here were kept because their sign-in is not marked as expired.
